# A first year, kept with care by orders (plan.md, "A first year, as played"): the hold of year-days.txt, whose
# first lines are that script's own orders as its log printed them, and then what a player does who looks in each
# morning and reads what the screen says: the land within a walk gathered every other day, its water fished every
# fourth, a wood felled before the timber runs out, and another stockpile marked when the stores say "No room".
#   build/odincraft --dwarves=57600 --orders=docs/interesting-world/real/play/year-orders.txt
